0022600154.text: The Orlando Magic (1-3, 0-2 at home, 11th in the East) host the Boston Celtics (3-1, 3-0 at home, 3rd in the East), who have won three straight after a 0-1 start on the road. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 113-108 win in Boston in April.
